notes.title: New Release - Error: Human Not Found
notes.notes: In the future how will humans and AI interact. Error: Human Not Found seeks to explore this concept and show how the unique interactions might happen. Namely what would happen if an AI was murdered on a research station floating in space. As the player you will need to solve puzzles and explore the levels in order to solve this mystery. Your choices determine the fate of AI and Human interactions.

notes.title: New Release - Error: Human Not Found
notes.notes: As one of Cellec’s most recent releases Error: Human Not Found will give players a new mystery to solve. With the death of an AI a researcher and another AI will work together to solve this murder. Error: Human Not Found is a visual novel/murder mystery with puzzle elements. The game also gives players insight on computer engineering and uses this knowledge to deliver a unique story.
